The [[Droknar's Key]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[reward trophy]] that each [[character]] may obtain once from [[Droknar]] in the [[Epilogue]] after completing [[A Time for Heroes]]. Exchange it with one of the Chests (listed below) located in the Epilogue for a unique item.

==Collectors==
*[[Warrior's Chest]]
*[[Ranger's Chest]]
*[[Monk's Chest]]
*[[Necromancer's Chest]]
*[[Mesmer's Chest]]
*[[Elementalist's Chest]]
*[[Assassin's Chest]]
*[[Ritualist's Chest]]
*[[Paragon's Chest]]
*[[Dervish's Chest]]

== Notes ==
* [[Diamond Key]]s have the same inventory icon. Beware of [[scam]]s.
* As noted, the game considers ''Droknar's Key'' to be a type of trophy rather than a [[key]]; instead of opening a [[chest]], it is technically exchanged with a [[collector]] that appears in the form of a chest.
